messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @jules — High error rate observed for /v1/models/*/infer in us-west-2 (errors spike ~20:41 UTC). Alerts: 5xx ratio > 15% for 3m. Auto-escalation to incidents channel.

jules: on it, joining bridge. any customer impact visible yet?

priya: checking metrics/alerts - looks like increased 502s from the console routing layer. Customer telemetry shows ~8 requests failing per min from a single high-traffic tenant. not widespread yet.

marco: adding runtime logs from the first minute we saw spike:
```
2026-06-12T20:41:05Z runtime[pool-3]: kvcache miss ctx=abc123 model=redwood-v2 seq=512
2026-06-12T20:41:06Z runtime[pool-3]: downstream proxy returned 502 for host=node-12.usw2
2026-06-12T20:41:07Z runtime[pool-3]: fallback to model-quantized triggered
```

sam: console shows control plane config version 42 for tenant A (routes: region=us-west-2 -> nodepool=prod-a). API calls to /v1/tenants/A/config are returning v41.

anya: can we confirm whether the dataplane has picked up v42? that'd explain console/api mismatch.

jules: good call. marco, can you run a quick check against dataplane agent on node-12?

marco: running now - curl to agent:
```
curl -sS http://node-12.internal:8081/agent/config | jq '.config_version'
# returns: 41
```

marco: dataplane agent still on 41. control plane (console) shows 42. seems like propagation stalled.

priya: timeline so far: 20:38 rite: control plane rollout started (v42) -> 20:41 alerts appear -> 20:42 partial propagation detected -> 20:43 dataplane mismatch observed.

jules: mitigation: routing fallback to regional-stable for tenant A. sam, can you initiate temporary routing policy to avoid node-12?

sam: done — applied policy: exclude node-12 for tenant A at 20:44 UTC. traffic shifted, error rate dropping to ~2% in the last 2m.

ops-bot: action recorded: policy.exclude node-12 tenant=A by sam at 2026-06-12T20:44:02Z

anya: still need to figure out why agent didn't pick up v42. could be grpc stream disconnection or a flag gating rollout. marco, any logs from config-propagator?

marco: propagator logs around rollout:
```
2026-06-12T20:38:01Z propagator: start rollout v42 -> tenants: A,B,C
2026-06-12T20:38:05Z propagator: push to control plane db ok
2026-06-12T20:38:07Z propagator: notify agents via push stream
2026-06-12T20:39:00Z propagator: received ACKs from 98% agents
2026-06-12T20:39:02Z propagator: missing ACKs: node-12, node-17
```

marco: node-12 shows a backpressure/timeout when opening the push stream at 20:38:07. stack trace shows TLS handshake timeout.

priya: hypothesis 1: agent network egress to control plane was briefly failing -> missed push, remained on v41 -> console displays intended state v42.

jules: hypothesis 2: rollout gating flag incorrectly set for certain nodepools (prod-a) causing controller to mark rollout complete even though some agents were excluded. need to check rollout controller code path.

sam: I can confirm the rollout controller returned success when 95% ACK threshold met; nodepool prod-a was at 94% because node-12/17 didn't ack. sounds like config threshold logic could mask partial propagation.

anya: customer impact assessment: tenant A experienced 12% error budget burn over 6m window, but fallback avoided broader outage. impacted requests predominantly long-context (seq > 512) which triggered fallback code.

marco: immediate remediation steps:
- re-open control plane -> agent TLS connectivity for node-12
- force re-push config v42 to node-12
- monitor KV cache and infer errors for 10m

jules: marco, run force push and paste command output. priya, please start draft incident timeline for RCA. sam, add a post-rollback flag to prevent controller from marking rollout complete below nodepool threshold.

marco: force push output:
```
2026-06-12T20:46:22Z propagator: pushing v42 to node-12
2026-06-12T20:46:24Z node-12: accepted config v42
2026-06-12T20:46:25Z propagator: ACK from node-12
```

marco: node-12 now reports config_version=42. runtime logs post-push show no more immediate 502s for that tenant on that host.

priya: updating timeline: 20:46 config accepted, 20:47 error rates near-normal.

jules: keeping channel open for 30m for warmup/observability. for RCA thread: we need to capture:
- full timeline (push->acks->alerts)
- list of affected tenant requests and sample traces (ask CS to share)
- propagator failure mode: TLS/connectivity vs controller logic
- follow-ups: change rollout thresholds, add agent health probe to detect missed configs, backfill missing ACK telemetry for observability

anya: noted. I'll ping CS for sample traces and customer impact note.

sam: quick follow-up — there is a console/API discrepancy window while rollout is in-progress. console shows desired state (v42) and API /tenants/A/config returned v41 until node-12 accepted. we should document this state-drift for runbook mention: console != applied state.

jules: agreed — add runbook step: when console/API mismatch, check per-agent config_version via agent endpoint and search propagator missing ACKs.

ops-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. bridge scheduled close at 2026-06-12T21:16:00Z if no regressions.

jules: thanks team. final notes: root cause candidate = partial rollout + agent connectivity gap. follow-ups assigned: sam (rollout threshold change), marco (agent TLS retry hardening), priya (RCA writeup + timeline). closing in 30m. :thumbsup:
